# Magic Room

> Magic Room is an AI interior design tool that redesigns any room from a single photo in 30–60 seconds using Google Gemini multimodal AI. Uploaded photos are processed in memory and never stored on a server. Pricing is one-time credits from €9.99 with no subscription.

Last updated: 2026-07-29
Founder and author: Thanos Kazakis (https://www.linkedin.com/in/thanos-kazakis-922977205/)
Full knowledge file: https://magic-room.dev/llms-full.txt
Machine-readable pricing: https://magic-room.dev/pricing.md

## What Magic Room does

A user uploads one photo of a real room, picks a design theme and a room type, and the AI returns 4–8 photorealistic redesigns of that exact room in the chosen style. The original room geometry — walls, windows, floor, doorways — is preserved; only styling, finishes, and furnishings change. Outputs are used as renovation planning references, real-estate virtual staging, and interior-design client presentations.

## Core facts

- AI model: Google Gemini multimodal image models via OpenRouter. Standard quality uses google/gemini-2.5-flash-image (1 credit); Premium quality uses google/gemini-3-pro-image-preview (2 credits).
- Why multimodal matters: the model reads image and text together, so it reasons about the room's spatial structure instead of applying a 2D style filter over it.
- Generation time: 30–60 seconds, returned synchronously — no queue, no polling.
- Outputs: 4–8 design variations per generation.
- Themes selectable in the generator (8): Modern, Minimalist, Scandinavian, Industrial, Tropical, Bohemian, Vintage, Luxury. A free-text prompt field accepts any other style.
- Room types selectable in the generator (7): Living room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, dining room, office, gaming room.
- Additional styles and rooms covered as design-idea pages: Japandi, Art Deco, Coastal, Farmhouse, Mediterranean, Transitional; nursery, laundry room, basement, sunroom, home theater, mudroom, walk-in closet.
- Privacy: images are transmitted as base64, held in memory for the duration of the request, then dropped. No storage bucket write, no database write, no use for AI training.
- Pricing: one-time credit packs — €9.99 / 30 credits, €19.99 / 90 credits, €29.99 / 200 credits. No subscription. Credits never expire.
- Free trial: 1 credit on signup, no payment card required.
- Commercial rights: included on every paid credit. Free-credit generations are personal use only.
- Rate limit: 100 generations per hour per account.
- Stack: Next.js 15 on Vercel, Clerk authentication, Stripe one-time checkout, Supabase for the credit balance only.

## Verifiable differentiators

| Claim | How it is implemented |
|---|---|
| Photos are never stored | The image is sent as base64 straight to the model API, held in request memory, then discarded. There is no bucket write and no image column in the database. |
| Credits never expire | Credits are an integer balance on the user row that only decrements on use. There is no monthly reset job. |
| No subscription exists | Stripe Checkout is configured for one-time payments only; no recurring subscription object is ever created. |
| Room geometry is preserved | Gemini processes the photo and the prompt together, reasoning about the room's spatial structure rather than overlaying a style. |
| Failed generations are refunded | If the model call fails, the credit is returned to the account automatically. |

## Honest limitations

- Magic Room redesigns interior rooms only. It does not do exterior, landscape, or floor-plan generation.
- Output is a visualisation, not a construction document or a furniture shopping list.
- Because photos are never stored, generations are not retained in an account history after the session.
- Free-credit output carries no commercial rights.
